title: It’s my first time
body: I did the bedtime routine and think this is the first time I have brushed my teeth and done my skincare before bed in I don’t know how long! Feels so lovely have a fresh mouth and clean face before bed. Can’t wait to try the other videos out and my first live tomorrow so I can sort out my bedroom of doom and turn it into my haven again. Thank you for creating this app!
author: Jayfoxie

title: I love this.
body:
I forget that I downloaded it but now with nudges I just have to remember to put nudges 

I love it. 
I love the color, the font, how everything is structured. 
It helps. 
I still feel ashamed of adhd especially for how people around me act about it, but Rox and Rich make it all easier and I feel understood. 
Thank you
author: tsukinoyui
